name: mechanical-face
description: Mechanical conditions applied to deformable-block boundary faces with 'block face apply' — stress (traction), point loads, and prescribed normal velocity. A 'range' is REQUIRED on 'block face apply <condition> <value>' — omitting it is rejected with 'A range must be specified' (live 9.7.47).

notes: Applied as a face traction over the selected faces; compression is negative.
'stress' takes the full tensor; 'stress-normal' the face-normal component; 'stress-principal' principal values (all live-enumerated).
A concentrated load distributed to the face.
'block face apply-remove' names these 'load'/'load-x'/'load-y'/'load-z' (NOT point-load) — live-enumerated rename on the removal side.

notes: The enumeration is context-free: identical with and without 'model configure thermal/dynamic/fluid-flow' — thermal (convection, flux) and water (westergaard) keywords are always visible.
Thermal conditions: see thermal-and-dynamic; flux/westergaard: see fluid-flow; gradient-x/y/z, fish, table: see apply-modifiers.
